seo.title: About Studio 101
seo.description: Studio 101 is the commercial production evolution of Canwill-Smith Photography.

settings.heading: Engineered for Visual Perfection
paragraphs: Studio 101 represents the commercial production evolution of Canwill-Smith Photography.

Built in 2026, Studio 101 was designed to eliminate the compromises found in standard rental spaces. From acoustics to lighting trusses and client amenities, every square foot is optimized for speed, luxury, and visual impact.
Whether hosting high-profile celebrity podcasts, commercial ad filming, or music video sets, our space delivers absolute control over lighting, sound, and mood.

settings.heading: Engineered for Elite Creators
settings.intro: Designed from the ground up to combine corporate luxury aesthetics with maximum production flexibility and high-tier equipment.

items.title: Acoustics & Lighting
items.text: Features dark soundproofed suites with acoustic treatment, automated moving-head lighting trusses, and customizable color environments.

items.title: Luxury Hospitality
items.text: Designed with rich burgundy velvet accents, private green rooms, makeup vanity stations, high-speed fiber internet, and client lounges.

items.title: Multi-Set Versatility
items.text: Transition seamlessly between clean white infinity cycloramas, green screen setups, podcast tables, and dynamic music video stages.

settings.heading: Ready to Elevate Your Next Project?
settings.text: Our signature standard package starts at R1,300.00 for 1 Hour 30 Mins of full studio access, professional gear, and dedicated support.
